newsitem.title: MEXICO: Sidek temporarily suspended on Bolsa.
newsitem.headline: Sidek temporarily suspended on Bolsa.

text.p: Trade in Mexican holding company Grupo Sidek's A, B and L shares has been temporarily suspended, the Mexican Stock Exchange said on Wednesday.
The steel-to-tourism company has had considerable debt problems since the Mexican peso devaluation crisis of December 1994.
The bolsa gave no reason for the suspension.
Sidek ADRs were delisted from the New York Stock Exchange last Thursday, an NYSE spokeswoman said. Sidek said Monday it would seek to trade its shares over the counter in New York.
